reason: Document A stands out from the dozens of charter captain comments we hear at every meeting because Captain Dunn is completely transparent—even volunteering that 70% of his upcoming season is already booked and refusing to exaggerate how many boats will close—while offering concrete compromises like trip logs and catch-reporting app testing. Document B is well-written, but it offers nothing in return from the fleet and reads much more like the standard testimony we hear every month.
